identity_normalization.compressed_policy: binary-exact-v1; never decompress or normalize for identity comparison
identity_normalization.derivation: Recovered snapshot preimage bytes were first verified against both original captured raw before/after SHA-256 digests; only then were their normalized before/after digests derived. No changed post-run file supplies an executed digest.
identity_normalization.text_mapping: Replace CRLF pairs by LF only. Preserve lone CR, all other whitespace, content and final newline.

observed_only_note: Observed-only Python files were present in the identity snapshot but were not executed by this measured experiment. Their hashes are not presented as measured-method execution bindings.
snapshot: Before/after identity captured around the selected native execution, not an integration-time hash of new analysis.
